messages:
Mikaela (docs): Heads-up — opened docs PR to add a small PKCS#11 jitter & fallback example for on‑prem HSM setups. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/472

Samir (eng): thanks! can you paste the snippet here? easier to review quick

Mikaela (docs): sure, small YAML block — meant to clarify retry behaviour when slot contention occurs:

```yaml
kms:
  provider_path: /usr/lib/libpkcs11.so
  slot: 1
  token_label: redwood_hsm
  retry:
    attempts: 5
    base_backoff_ms: 100
    jitter_ms: 75
  fallback: soft-fail
```

Leo (eng-infra): soft-fail -> what does that mean in docs? we should be explicit (logs, observable signal) :thinking:

Mikaela (docs): good call. i'll replace soft-fail with `fallback_policy: degrade_to_software_kms` and add note about metric `kms.hsm.fallback_count` and log message `hsm-fallback-triggered`

Samir (eng): also add a short note for air-gapped installs: if `provider_path` changes during packaging, we recommend checksum pinning. e.g. `sha256: abc123...`

Docs-bot: Linkcheck failed on line referencing internal KMS RFC (404) — @Mikaela can you update the target to /kb/kms-onprem-routing?

Mikaela (docs): ack, will update and push new commit in ~20m. adding @security-ops for HSM policy wording.

security-ops: quick flag — don't use example token_label 'admin' in public docs. prefer 'redwood_hsm' or 'customer_hsm'. Also mention PKCS11 slot numbering varies by vendor.

DevEx: thanks, also can we add a short "quick test" command for offline users:

```bash
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/hsm/lib ./kms-cli --pkcs11 /usr/lib/libpkcs11.so --slot 1 ping
```

Mikaela (docs): added test command and updated wording. pushing now.

Samir (eng): LGTM; small nit — move the airgap checksum paragraph into 'preflight' section, not install.

Mikaela (docs): done. PR updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/472/files

Leo (eng-infra): ran local build, no more linkcheck errors, example renders fine. :shipit:

Mikaela (docs): thanks all :tada:

Docs-bot: Merged by Mikaela — docs PR #472
